page.overview:
What is The Weird Sisters?

The Weird Sisters were a very popular band in the wizarding world, whose music was frequently played on the Wizarding Wireless Network. Despite their name, all eight known members were male.

Many individuals in the wizarding world were fans of the Weird Sisters, including Ginevra Weasley and Nymphadora Tonks, the latter of which had a poster of the band hanging on her bedroom wall.

Myron Wagtail, Kirley Duke, and Orsino Thruston formed the Weird Sisters in the 1986–1987 school year, when they were students at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. They recruited a non-musician student to perform their song "Do the Hippogriff" with them for their debut concert, in Hogwarts Castle, teaching the student how to transfigure and charm a cauldron to play automatically. Afterward, Donaghan Tremlett replaced the student as the full-time bass player. During the same year, the band cited the student, who had become known as an unofficial "Curse-Breaker" as an inspiration. They helped them practice for the Frog Choir audition, including encouraging them to sing in front of Professor Snape.

During the 1987–1988 school year, Charles Weasley and the student hosted a party at The Burrow; the Weird Sisters played after the latter helped Wagtail overcome a creative block, leading the singer to give them a special shout-out. During the 1988–1989 school year, Wagtail found inspiration for the song "Blood Sucker" when he incorporated the vocals of a chupacabra, brought to rehearsal by its carer, who also helped with the lyrics.
